display.purpose: Page h1 and the sign-in heading; 40px under 834px, ruled off from content by a hairline.

totem-price.purpose: The price on each fuel field, with a 22px 600 $/L unit; 56px on phones, 48px under 420px. Counts up on arrival.

figure.purpose: KPI values (60px for the lead figure), board facts 44px, tank percentages 40px, till result 72px; tabular.

headline.purpose: h2 and card header titles; 28-36px in sheet and drawer headers.

name.purpose: Uppercase fuel names on the totem, station name in the rail (27px) and top bar (24px); shift-line stops at 600 17px 0.03em.

body.purpose: Default text and inputs; buttons at 16px 600.

column-head.purpose: Table heads, sentence case, faint text on the well colour.

shadows.name: panel-hairline
shadows.purpose: Resting edge of every card; there is no resting drop shadow.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: --shadow-lift: drawers (with an inset 1px 0 0 hairline), action sheets, toasts, tooltips, quick-action hover. Day: rgba(10, 10, 11, 0.18).

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Centred alerts and phone bottom sheets.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global focus; fields use box-shadow 0 0 0 2px var(--focus) with the border in text colour.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default: arrivals, drawers, totem fill, sheen, view transitions.

motion.name: page-arrival
motion.purpose: Once per navigation; ruled bands and the board arrive as one piece.

motion.name: totem-fill
motion.value: clip-path inset from the bottom, 0.9s, stagger 80ms; sheen 1.1s at 0.75s
motion.purpose: Price totem fields fill like a tank, then one white sheen crosses them.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Totem prices, KPI values, facts, tank percentages, till result; the final text is already in the DOM.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: Route changes via View Transitions, with CSS fallbacks.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: Forms on wide screens; phones use a 0.45s bottom sheet.

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--accent, #f5f4ef); color: var(--on-accent, #0a0a0b); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.012em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #ffffff); } .ds-btn:active { background: var(--accent-press, #d9d8d2); transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #ffc414); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; display: block; width: 280px; } .ds-field input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 25px 16px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--separator, #2e2e33); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-2, #0f0f11); color: var(--text, #f5f4ef); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -0.022em; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-field span { position: absolute; top: 17px; left: 17px; color: var(--text-2, #aaa9a3); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 21px; pointer-events: none; transform-origin: left top; transform: translateY(-9px) scale(0.705); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--text, #f5f4ef); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--focus, #ffc414); }

components.css: .ds-totem { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 240px); gap: 12px; } .ds-totem-panel { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 168px; padding: 18px 22px 20px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--product); color: #0a0a0b; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; animation: ds-fill 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; } .ds-totem-panel:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.08s; } .ds-totem-panel::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 35%, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 50%, transparent 65%); transform: translateX(-110%); animation: ds-sheen 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.75s both; } .ds-totem-name { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-totem-price { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 18px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 84px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.8; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-totem-price small { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-totem-sub { margin-top: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } @keyframes ds-fill { from { clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0 round 14px); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0 round 14px); } } @keyframes ds-sheen { to { transform: translateX(110%); } }

components.css: .ds-line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 120px); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-line li { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding-top: 2px; } .ds-line li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 20px; right: -2px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--fill, #34343a); transform-origin: left; animation: ds-grow 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) both; } .ds-line li:last-child::before { display: none; } .ds-line li.done::before { background: var(--brand, #ffc414); } .ds-stop { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg, #0a0a0b); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--fill, #34343a); } .done .ds-stop { background: var(--brand, #ffc414); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--brand, #ffc414); } .now .ds-stop { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 6px var(--brand, #ffc414); } .ds-lbl { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-3, #85847e); } .done .ds-lbl { color: var(--text-2, #aaa9a3); } .now .ds-lbl { color: var(--text, #f5f4ef); } @keyframes ds-grow { from { transform: scaleX(0); } }

narrative.overview:
The app is the station's price totem at night, seen from the forecourt: a black ground, porcelain type, and the day's prices lit in one colour field per fuel. Gasoil is green, essence is red, and each fuel owns its colour everywhere it appears (totem field, tank gauge, product swatch). Names and figures speak in Barlow Condensed, set big and bold like the numerals on a pylon; everything that is read rather than glanced at is in Inter. Actions are solid white rectangular slabs, one per region. The brand is a single lit yellow drop.

Density is that of an operating tool: a wide-screen side rail with an icon nav, a condensed headline ruled off from its content, the totem, then figures on one ruled board. On phones the rail folds into a top bar with the page name and a bottom tab bar, and the totem drops to two columns. The attendant uses the app on a phone with customers queuing, so the figures are large and the actions are few. A day mode keeps every role and swaps the values, for the pump in full sun.

This world replaces the apple.com tile grid and centred top nav that came before it (and the "Midnight Line" recolour of that layout). Panels are ruled by hairlines, never floated on resting shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Black ground (night) or bone ground (day), porcelain or ink text, no tinted neutrals.
Colour belongs to the fuels; the brand yellow is a signal, not a theme.
Barlow Condensed for names and figures, Inter for reading.
Ruled boards: panels share one surface divided by 1px hairlines.
White rectangular action slabs with a 10px radius.
Motion fills, counts and sweeps once per arrival, then stays still.

rules.name: The Colour Belongs to the Fuel Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only where a fuel is meant: its totem field, its tank, its swatch, its series. Totals, revenue bars and every non-product figure are porcelain (night) or ink (day).

rules.name: The Lit Drop Rule
rules.body: Brand yellow marks exactly four things: the brand drop, the active nav icon, the shift line's progress, and focus. It is never a button, a background or a heading colour.

rules.name: The Black Text on Fuel Rule
rules.body: Text on a fuel field is always night-ground black, in both modes, at solid weight; never white, never translucent.

rules.name: The Condensed Speaks Names and Figures Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is for headings, product and station names, and numbers that are glanced at. Sentences, labels, form text and buttons stay in Inter.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every money, litre and percentage figure uses tabular numerals so counts and columns stay aligned.

rules.name: The Ruled Board Rule
rules.body: Related panels share one surface: a grid with a 1px gap over the hairline colour, an outer hairline border, a 14px outer radius and square inner cells. The manager's dashboard board (six columns: chart 4, alerts 2, facts 3+3) and every band of figures are built this way, not as separate floating tiles.

rules.name: The Ruled, Not Floated Rule
rules.body: A panel at rest never carries a drop shadow; it is edged by a hairline or shares a ruled board.

dos: **Do** give each fuel its colour field and keep the text on it night-ground black and solid.
**Do** build related panels as one ruled board: 1px hairline gaps, a 14px outer radius, square inner cells.
**Do** set names and glanced-at figures in Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals, and everything read in Inter.
**Do** keep one porcelain (day: ink) slab button per region; secondary actions are outlined.
**Do** define every new colour twice, in `:root` and `:root[data-theme='light']`, with the same role.
**Do** keep focus visible as the 2px brand-yellow ring.
donts: **Don't** use gasoil green or essence red for anything that is not that fuel (totals, revenue, success, buttons).
**Don't** spread the brand yellow beyond the drop, the active nav icon, the shift line and focus.
**Don't** float resting panels on drop shadows or return to separate apple.com-style tiles and a centred top nav.
**Don't** put white or translucent text on a fuel field.
**Don't** set sentences, form labels or buttons in Barlow Condensed.
